description: This file defines the 'Delivery' embeddable class used to represent delivery address details in the software project, including fields for name, contact information, address, and related entities like country and zone.

classes.name: Delivery
classes.description: Embeddable Java class representing delivery address details with various address and contact fields.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Returns the company name associated with the delivery address.

methods.name: setCompany
methods.description: Sets the company name for the delivery address.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the street address for delivery.

methods.name: setAddress
methods.description: Sets the street address for delivery.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the city for delivery.

methods.name: setCity
methods.description: Sets the city for delivery.

methods.name: getPostalCode
methods.description: Returns the postal code for delivery.

methods.name: setPostalCode
methods.description: Sets the postal code for delivery.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the Country entity associated with delivery address.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Associates a Country entity with the delivery address.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Returns the Zone entity associated with delivery.

methods.name: setZone
methods.description: Associates a Zone entity with the delivery address.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the state or region for delivery.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state or region for delivery.

methods.name: getTelephone
methods.description: Returns the telephone number for delivery contact.

methods.name: setTelephone
methods.description: Sets the telephone number for delivery contact.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Returns the last name of the recipient.

methods.name: setLastName
methods.description: Sets the last name of the recipient.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the recipient.

methods.name: setFirstName
methods.description: Sets the first name of the recipient.
